title: Rock Island Railroad, Morris Passenger Depot, East of Liberty Avenue, Morris, Grundy County, IL
notes: Significance: One of several stations built around 1905 by the Rock Island Railroad, the Morris Passenger Station has distinctive hipped roof and dormer.
